theme: Goal-based investing: education, retirement, home, wedding funds
headline: Align Your Investments With Life Goals
body: Match your investment timeline to your goals. Shorter timelines need different approaches than longer ones.
caption: Every major life milestone deserves a thoughtful investment strategy. Start early, stay consistent, and review regularly. #GoalBasedInvesting #WealthBuilding #InvestmentStrategy #LifeGoals #SmartMoney
